## 席位核对
ACCEPT — L1 (card thread for #36511, reporting to area s2-C) at head `0a019af0d730ef0552c3afe87da5c23a197378c4` · 2026-11-23T02:29Z

- **Shape:** open draft to `main`; first line `Part of #36511` (PR 1 of 3; the card stays open and keeps `pm:dispatched` until the closing PR); no closing keyword anywhere in the body. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`, same two lines in the changeset. Size 1903+847 = 2750 changed lines, 48 files (≤ 3000). No governed path; no `packages/spec/**`, no server path.
- **Premise measured:** the save path is the existing per-item door. `studioSaveBar.tsx` `publishSavedItem` calls `MetadataClient.publish(type, name, { packageId })` after the draft write; a refused publish discards the just-written draft only when no draft was pending before (a pending copilot draft is kept). Live E2E proves it end to end against a real server (below).
- **Gates at this head:** check-runs 45 success · 13 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36597`, read 2026-11-23T02:29Z), Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success. Dogfood not owed (no `!`, no narrowing arm). Gates-ran file `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36511-pr1-gates-ran.txt` (39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, at 1d6c0845f5).
- **Patch round 1d6c0845f5 → 0a019af0d7** (CI red on the first head, both this PR's own consequence): Lint UI — seven rewritten `DataPillar.*.test.tsx` kept an unused `act` import, removed. Live E2E UI — **rewritten test, not yet named in the PR body's list:** `ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` step 3 (Add `region__c`). It now asserts zero `object_extension` writes after Add with Save visible; after Save, a `PUT` draft (`mode=draft`, `?package=` the pair) then `POST /meta/object_extension/showcase_task/publish?package=PAIR` that answers ok, Save gone, writes exactly `['PUT','POST']`, and `GET …?state=draft&package=PAIR` answers 404 (no draft left). The step's former `publishPair` is removed; the later server, pair-read and export assertions are unchanged. Green on Live E2E UI at this head. Local readings for the patch: app-shell lint exit 0, `tsc -p ui/tsconfig.e2e.json` exit 0, the 7 suites 18/18 under the verify lock.
- **Flipped pins load-bearing:** the rewritten autosave pins assert both halves of the ruled behaviour (nothing sent before Save; draft write then that item's publish after; Cancel restores). New suites `DataPillar.saveCancel-36511`, `studioSaveBar.partialSave-36511`, `StudioDesignSurface.saveBar-36511`. Retired pins are listed in the PR body with reasons.
- **Changeset read sentence by sentence** (`.changeset/36511-studio-save-cancel.md`): each sentence matches the diff, including "Other Studio editors (flows, hooks, list and form views, navigation, permissions) keep their draft autosave for now" (they move in PR 2 and PR 3).
- **Accepted deviations:** hooks and an installed app's own pair actions moved to PR 2 (the hooks buffer unmounts with its tab); `metadata-admin/CelPredicateField.tsx` imports `LINT_DEBOUNCE_MS` from the new `celLintDebounce.ts` (one-line move, so Save can wait out the lint). Studio has no delete-object affordance, so no dialog for it.
- **Two editors on one published object:** seat ruling 7089589821 on #36511 — accepted as a transitional window, server guard on #36601; the PR body says so. Save-time confirm for removing or retyping a published field kept, as the card asks. New i18n names `engine.studio.save.*` accepted by the seat (same ruling).
- **Out of scope, routed:** ADR sentences the new behaviour contradicts — ADR-0027 M2 "explicit, batched publish" and ADR-0037 "Publish remains the single commit gate" — `carrier: #36086`, a row at landing. Acceptance note (not filed): the object publish locator places no `validations.N.condition` path, so a rule refused at publish shows its reason under Details only.
- **Landing:** non-governed, ≤ 3000 lines; contract review not owed. Handed to the seat with PR number, full sha and this record id; this thread does not land.
